analysis.reasonEn: RSI shows a steady upward trend from mid-40s to 49.4 for 4 consecutive sessions. MACD histogram improved from 4222 to 3474 over 5 days but remains negative. Volume ratio at 0.89 indicates sideways movement without strong conviction. Price is up 8.47% vs SMA200 but down 10.28% vs SMA50, entering mid-term resistance. Current price is 36.7% of 52-week high. No clear trend reversal signal, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
